text:
katie: Heads-up: CI failed on docs build for PR #824 — mkdocs error about frontmatter YAML and some images redirecting to CDN -> 404. Anyone who's touching the Quickstart examples?

docs-ci-bot: build failed: mkdocs build exited 1
log: "while scanning a simple key" at docs/tutorials/quickstart.md:3

naveen: I'll take a quick look. which PR/branch is it?

katie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/824 — I moved a couple of example images under /static/assets/ and updated the mdx snippets.

eli: I ran into something similar yesterday — our image redirect rule on the CDN strips trailing spaces and some relative paths break. also the frontmatter linter will blow up on stray tabs/indentation.

sanjay: :eyes: lemme run mkdocs locally and reproduce.

katie: paste of the top of quickstart.md from the PR:
```
---
title: Quickstart
permalink: /quickstart/
  tags: [quickstart]  # <-- misindented (causes YAML parse error)
---
```

naveen: yep that's the YAML issue — `tags` is indented one extra space. easy fix.

eli: also noticed an image link with a trailing space: `![diagram](../static/assets/diagram.png )` — mkdocs will happily output a link that 404s because the CDN redirect normalizer hates the space.

sanjay: grep trick: `rg "\)\s$" -n docs | sed -n '1,50p'` to find trailing-space image links. I'll run and patch.

katie: :thumbsup: if you can fix both, I'll re-run the docs preview and merge once green.

naveen: pushing tiny PR to the branch now — fixes indent and strips trailing spaces from image links. commit msg: "docs(quickstart): fix frontmatter indent and clean image paths"

docs-ci-bot: CI: rebuild triggered for PR #824 (branch: fix/quickstart-frontmatter)

docs-ci-bot: CI: build succeeded, preview deployed -> https://deploy-preview-824.docs.redwood.com/tutorials/quickstart

eli: preview looks good; images render and no mkdocs warnings.

katie: awesome. can we add a small pre-commit hook or lint step so frontmatter issues get caught before CI?

naveen: I can add a yamllint job in the docs GH actions. will send a follow-up PR.

sanjay: I'll open an issue to add a tiny test that renders all markdown and checks for 200 on image assets — to catch CDN redirect quirks.

katie: thanks team. saved a few minutes of frantic rollback. I'll handle merge once the yamllint job is in place on main.
